info.background_text:
Perpetually unlucky girl.
An agent aboard the SS Nightmare who is reluctant to talk about her past. She has been plagued by misfortune throughout her life, and even now, large and small misfortunes seem to find her with unusual frequency. She constantly feels guilty for dragging others into her misfortune.
